mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND i.deleted = 0
SELECT project_id FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT variables_json FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM wf_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'DRAFT'

SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.task_key, t.node_id, t.task_type, t.status AS task_status, t.assignee_id, i.definition_id, i.version_no, i.business_key, i.business_type, i.business_title, i.business_round, i.project_id, i.project_ref, i.project_name, i.action_path, i.status AS instance_status, CAST(v.definition_json AS CHAR) AS definition_json FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id JOIN wf_version v ON v.definition_id = i.definition_id AND v.version_no = i.version_no AND v.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.business_type = #{businessType} AND i.business_key = #{businessKey} AND i.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.task_type <> 'CC' ORDER BY i.business_round DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND flowable_task_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT definition_json FROM wf_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT status FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
